metadata.title: One Piece
metadata.summary: Seeking to be the greatest pirate in the world, young Monkey D. Luffy, endowed with stretching powers from the legendary &quot;Gomu Gomu&quot; Devil's fruit, travels towards the Grand Line in search of One Piece, the greatest treasure in the world.
